title: Adjustments to Cooling-off Period for Digital Security Token Activation Based on High-risk Activities and Enhancing Fraud Surveillance Thresholds
what_it_is: Adjustments to Cooling-off Period for Digital Security Token Activation Based on High-risk Activities and Enhancing Fraud Surveillance Thresholds

sections.label: 12-hour cooling period digital token
sections.summary: A 12-hour minimum period applies to high-risk activities after a customer activates a digital security token, and SRF requires blocking or holding transactions above prescribed perimeters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I will first respond to the question on the 12-hour cooling period upon activation of a digital security token.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: This is a minimum period that financial institutions (FIs) must apply to specified high-risk activities once a customer has activated a digital security token on his or her mobile device.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: High-risk activities are typically performed by scammers during an account takeover to transfer funds without a customer's knowledge and this 12-hour minimum period thus gives customers sufficient time to act on abnormal activities on their account, while balancing inconvenience to customers from the undue friction to legitimate activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: SRF introduces a requirement to block or hold transactions above the prescribed perimeters.

sections.label: Payouts for SRF duty breach
sections.summary: If the FI or telco breaches any SRF duty, it is expected to provide payouts to the customer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If there is a breach of any SRF duty by the FI or the telco, the FI or telco is expected to provide payouts to the customer.

sections.label: Banks' $50,000 SRF threshold
sections.summary: Banks may go under the $50,000 threshold, which is prescribed for SRF fraud surveillance duties, and must compensate in phishing scams if they do not meet it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Banks also have their own internal surveillance systems and parameters, and they may choose to go under this $50,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But this $50,000 threshold is prescribed for the purpose of, as I mentioned earlier, the SRF's fraud surveillance duties, which if they do not meet as a baseline in a phishing scam, then the banks will have to pay out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If they do not, if it is a part of phishing scam, they will have to compensate.

sections.label: Protection from Scams Bill and MAS
sections.summary: The Protection from Scams Bill will let Police order banks to restrict potential scam victims' transactions, and MAS is studying stronger out-of-band authentication beyond the SRF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Yesterday, Minister of State Sun Xueling mentioned about the Protection from Scams Bill, which will allow the Police to order banks to restrict potential scam victims' banking transactions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, MAS is now studying stronger, out-of-band authentication solutions beyond the SRF to enhance defences against unauthorised phishing transactions.
